# AgentFuse

> Deterministic runtime circuit breaker and safety control plane for AI agents.

## Core Thesis
No LLM decides when your agent stops. AgentFuse enforces safety constraints deterministically during runtime rather than analyzing logs after the fact.

## Key Capabilities
- Loop detection: Sliding window tracking of identical tool calls via SHA-256 argument and response hashing.
- Budget firewall: Hard USD spend ceilings per agent run evaluated inline before LLM dispatch.
- In-process pause: Native LangGraph interrupt() nodes to freeze execution state without process crashes.
- Human review: Explicit operator approval required to apply recovery plans and resume paused runs.
- Audit compliance: Immutable PostgreSQL event log with cryptographic state attribution.

## Integration Example (LangGraph)
```python
from agentfuse import AgentFuse, LangGraphAdapter
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph

adapter = LangGraphAdapter(agent_id="support_agent")
fuse = AgentFuse(adapter=adapter)

builder = StateGraph(dict)
builder.add_node("safety_gate", fuse.safety_gate)
builder.set_entry_point("safety_gate")
builder.add_edge("safety_gate", "agent_worker")
builder.add_edge("agent_worker", "safety_gate")
graph = builder.compile()
```

## Machine API Contract
- OpenAPI schema available at: /openapi.json
- Health check: GET /health
- Telemetry stream: GET /api/stream (SSE)
- Incidents queue: GET /api/incidents
- Plan approval: POST /api/incidents/{incident_id}/plan/approve
